answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 15354 Country: India Title: can i name my daughter afifa wht is it meaning? Question: can i name my daughter afifa wht is it meaning? Answer ID: 15354 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1334/1334=M/1430) You can keep her name as Afifah , it is n ice name. It means: chaste. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
